.github/workflows/native-runtime.yml:nat.name: Boot clean native guest, invoke, reboot, retain and purge
Prepare private exact-source host workspace without changing runner ACLs
Provision host QEMU and independent verification trust
.github/workflows/native-runtime.yml:nat.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qemu-system-x86 qemu-utils cloud-image-utils openssh-client
if test -c /dev/kvm; then sudo setfacl -m "u:$(id -un):rw" /dev/kvm; fi
gh --version
gh attestation trusted-root > "$NATIVE_TRUST/trusted_root.jsonl"
